__comment: Beneath variant of tfc_strip_logs (this whole datapack loads only when the 'beneath' mod is present, see BeneathDataPack). Beneath's nether woods use TFC's naming (beneath:wood/log/<crimson|warped>, all four forms) and join #minecraft:logs (via #tfc:crimson_logs/#tfc:warped_logs), so the same template works with the beneath:wood/log/ path filter: each Beneath log -> its stripped log / wood / stripped wood. Non-existent forms are pruned by MineColonies.
